claim: Hold the existing 500mm receive in the 2027 CORRA H/M/U/Z strip, with lower conviction. The near-end Canadian path still looks aggressive relative to domestic evidence, but the actual book owns the full 2027 strip rather than March alone. That longer expression carries more exposure to the oil/inflation regime, so the Sep 28 Brent rebound is a real challenge to the trade rather than a cosmetic headline.

competing_explanations.statement: the Sep 28 Brent rebound is a real challenge to the trade rather than a cosmetic headline.

falsifiers.statement: A sustained cheapening of the full 2027 CORRA strip, particularly alongside March above roughly 3.20, remains elevated oil, and Canadian core/labor or BoC evidence validating additional tightening, should trigger reduction or closure. If domestic Canada remains soft and the strip richens despite oil, continue to hold.
